book.title: 2Tesalonika Tesalonika Ekalesia veize Pauloꞌa Mirihiroteꞌe Soꞌaḡa Aheuḡa

content: Kuranoga veize Umiziro
Ḡonagano, nego nabudi, emeḡe veize kuranoꞌi. Aꞌe, Zuhiꞌa Boro hari manoḡaniꞌa zae boꞌaḡano bororaroteꞌe teige, vaze niduꞌa boꞌaḡano bororanadu zeꞌa mae ḡihinoga veize raꞌohe.
Ebu emeḡe sausaufeꞌeteꞌe azaḡa sauꞌa mazaonoꞌo Badiꞌaꞌa ḡabofoga veize kuranoꞌi, mazaḡa vaze boꞌaḡano mene niduꞌaꞌe Badiꞌa mazao fieꞌohe.
Rehano Zuhiꞌa Boroꞌe zamaḡa niduꞌa hina haḡaeꞌe ꞌahine, sauꞌa ḡauḡa, Satani mazaonoꞌo zae inaraziꞌuma zu biriꞌuma.
Zaꞌe Zuhiꞌa Boro mone azaḡa ꞌahine, emeꞌa haḡaoꞌi rae ziroteꞌe haḡaiḡa izidi haḡaeꞌeteꞌe ebu haḡae onamiteꞌe moneo emeꞌa hube hune edereꞌohe.

Zuhiꞌa Boroꞌa zamaze ibitohanadu Badiꞌaꞌa nougenouge zae zamare borofeꞌeteꞌe zaeꞌa ederifine emeꞌa kurauꞌohe, ebu Kerisoꞌa aduga zamaḡano zamaḡa obone giganiroteꞌe zaeꞌa ederadu zae zuni ꞌouge haḡaifine kurauꞌohe.
Tubuḡa Azaḡa Riḡa Iraduguziro
Nego nabudi, eme emeḡe Zuhiꞌa Boro Iesu Keriso niḡano riḡa ziꞌohe. Iniu tubuḡa zu emeḡeꞌa ihozidoteꞌe ihoreḡa idunaḡano mene radiuꞌeteꞌe negoḡa nabuga niduꞌa mazaonoꞌo vaḡinoꞌi.
Za zaeꞌa bare edeḡa, za nougenouge eme tuhutuhufiꞌuma. Emeḡeꞌa zae teite radiunuteꞌe madaḡano emeꞌe mene tubuḡa reiro.
Eme vaze ogomuꞌe naeḡa oꞌoꞌa mene mae au tauḡiro. Ebu zae boꞌaḡano vazeni ꞌahoga aduga mene hanoga veize, eme ohere zu madai, mada niduga gau boro inare haḡairo.
Emeꞌa ꞌouge haḡairotaꞌaꞌe mene mazaḡa zae mazaonoꞌo ogomu meiteꞌe inaraḡaꞌe oꞌoꞌa, rehano emeḡe haḡai zaeꞌa horonadu zae zuni emeḡe hegotifine raꞌohe.
Emeꞌa zae teite radiunuteꞌe madaḡano ꞌahige zido, “Iniuꞌa gauoga mene uratine, aniꞌe ogomu anoga zuni mene idaḡa.”
Emeꞌa zae hari igiꞌetene, zae boꞌaḡano nuꞌe tubuḡa raꞌohe. Zeꞌe mene gaueꞌenaꞌa, vaze daꞌo dudizeꞌohe.
ꞌUguḡa azaḡaꞌe emeḡeꞌa Zuhiꞌa Boro Iesu Keriso niḡano ꞌahige riḡa ziꞌohe zu ihozeꞌohe, “Zaꞌe sifu gauoꞌi ebu zaeꞌa bare gauadu ogomu hidoꞌi.”
Nego nabudi, zaꞌe haḡai manoḡa haḡaeꞌeteꞌe zamaḡano ago fuḡozoꞌi.
Iniu vazeꞌa emeḡeꞌa soꞌa ꞌada ihoziroteꞌe ḡoeꞌa mene hegotoꞌidene, vaze eꞌe faifaine ḡianoꞌi ebu ani teite ago zaꞌuoꞌi. ꞌOugine, ani aneꞌa bare mazagaroniꞌuma.
Rehano aniꞌe zae agire vazeḡa rae ago zamaroꞌi, rehano zae nego teige riḡa iradugunoꞌi.
Ḡoere Ḡonaga
Zama roḡeḡa rifiꞌeteꞌe Zuhiꞌaḡa Boroꞌa iḡaiḡa ibi niduꞌa zamaḡano ane zama roḡeḡa ziniꞌenoꞌi. Zuhiꞌa Boroꞌe zae niduꞌa teite radiuꞌenoꞌi.
Uhiu ḡoeꞌa ꞌahiꞌe eḡe, Pauloꞌa eḡe ꞌevore hina miriheꞌohe. Aꞌe eḡe soꞌa niduꞌa zamaḡano eḡeꞌa mirihiro rae ihozeꞌeteꞌe tahiḡa, zu eḡeꞌa miriheꞌeteꞌe ibiḡa.
Emeḡe Zuhiꞌa Boro Iesu Kerisoꞌa zae niduꞌa mazao manoḡa fureneꞌenoꞌi.
